title: Optimal score function estimation via derivatives constraints
summary: We provide a statistical theory explaining why empirical score matching can achieve minimax optimal performance for diffusion generative models when the data distribution is supported on a low-dimensional manifold. More precisely, we establish convergence rates for empirical risk minimization over suitably constrained Sobolev classes and show that, under appropriate regularity conditions, the resulting score estimators lead to minimax optimal Wasserstein-1 rates for the generated distribution, up to logarithmic factors.
